name: query-table-monorepo
description: Schema-driven data table — core, react, and ui packages.
author: Pythia Software

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @pythia-software/query-table-core && npm run build --workspace @pythia-software/query-table-react && npm run build --workspace @pythia-software/query-table-ui && npm run build --workspace @pythia-software/query-table-codegen
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/react/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ui/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p tools/schema-codegen/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p examples/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p demo/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:sqlite: (cd backends/sqlite-tests && go test -race ./... && go vet ./...) && tsc -p backends/sqlite-tests/tsconfig.json && vitest run --config backends/sqlite-tests/vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:postgres: cd backends/postgres-tests && go test -race ./... && go vet ./...
scripts.package:lint: publint packages/core && publint packages/react && publint packages/ui && publint tools/schema-codegen && attw packages/core --pack --profile esm-only && attw packages/react --pack --profile esm-only && attw packages/ui --pack --profile esm-only --exclude-entrypoints ./theme.css && attw tools/schema-codegen --pack --profile esm-only
scripts.package:check: npm run build:packages && npm run package:lint && node scripts/verify-packages.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:go && npm run vet:go && npm run test:sqlite
scripts.release:check: npm run version:check && npm run check && npm run build:demo && npm run package:check && npm run audit
scripts.test:grouping: node demo/grouping-library-test.mjs && node demo/grouping-test.mjs && node demo/representative-test.mjs && node demo/grouping-editor-test.mjs && node demo/grouping-landscape-test.mjs && npm run test:grouping-metrics && node demo/grouping-migration-test.mjs
scripts.test:properties: node demo/properties-test.mjs && node demo/property-editor-test.mjs && node demo/detail-page-test.mjs && node demo/item-modal-test.mjs && node demo/item-inline-test.mjs
